newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's cabinet to set up national defence panel.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's cabinet to set up national defence panel.

text.p: Kuwait's cabinet on Sunday approved a plan to establish an eight-member National Defence Council (NDC) that would come up with strategies to safeguard the tiny Gulf Arab state.
The creation of NDC "comes to serve the requirements of national security in all fields," said a cabinet statement.
"NDC aims at guaranteeing the safety and security of the country and to set strategic policies, programmes and plans to achieve that goal," said the statement.
The decree proposal to set up the council would be enacted when approved by the Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
NDC would group six ministers, the chief of National Guards and the chairman of the national defence apparatus, a body that would be created to give technical assistance to NDC.
